item.title: [ABC Action News / Tampa Bay 28] Clearwater man 'late for work' arrested for driving 107 mph on bridge: PCSO
item.description: A Clearwater man said he was “late for work” when he was arrested on Wednesday for driving 107 mph on the Bayside Bridge, authorities said.
